description: Engineering feasibility screen for the routed transcript body, excluding annotated poly(A). Thresholds are design choices, not biological viability boundaries.

provenance.settings: Global 40-60%; local 30-70% in 50 nt. This preset uses stride 1.
Reject A/T runs >=10 and G/C runs >=6; RNA U corresponds to template T.
Avoid repeats longer than 20 bp. Nonoverlapping exact 21-mer copies are this preset's operational definition.
Primitive tandem period 2-6 nt, at least 18 nt and 3 complete copies; requires sensitivity analysis.
